verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company incorporation and back-office service covering registered agent, compliance, accounting, banking access and mailroom. It has no AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it to use their tools is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP-client capability, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
